description: Generates AI audio: a voiceover (mode=speech) from text, or music (mode=music) from a description. Returns a link to the mp3 file. Spends credits (price in fattly_list_models → audio); refunded automatically if the generation fails.

text.description: Text to read (speech) or a music description (music).

voice.description: Voiceover voice, e.g. Rachel, Aria, George (speech only).

name: fattly_generate_audio
title: Generate a voiceover or music
